description: This file defines the interface for the IShell component within the Thunder plugin framework, including nested interfaces, enums, and class declarations related to plugin management, remote connections, and web server control.

classes.name: IShell
classes.description: Main interface for plugin shell management, including nested interfaces for remote connection handling, plugin state control, and web server management.

classes.name: ICOMLink
classes.description: Nested interface for managing COM link connections and notifications.

classes.name: INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for remote connection dangling and revocation events.

classes.name: IConnectionServer
classes.description: Nested interface for managing connection server notifications.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: Represents a dispatchable job to change plugin state (activate/deactivate).

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static method to create a Job instance for changing plugin state.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Executes the job, activating or deactivating the plugin based on internal state.

methods.name: EnableWebServer
methods.description: Enables the web server for the plugin with specified URL path and filesystem path.

methods.name: DisableWebServer
methods.description: Disables the web server for the plugin.

methods.name: Model
methods.description: Returns a human-readable model name of the platform.

methods.name: Background
methods.description: Indicates if the plugin host runs in daemon mode.

methods.name: Accessor
methods.description: Returns an identifier for connecting to the webbridge.

methods.name: WebPrefix
methods.description: Returns the web prefix used in URL routing.

methods.name: Locator
methods.description: Returns the name of the binary that holds the class code.

methods.name: ClassName
methods.description: Returns the class name to instantiate.

methods.name: Callsign
methods.description: Returns the specific plugin's callsign.

methods.name: PersistentPath
methods.description: Returns the persistent storage path.

methods.name: VolatilePath
methods.description: Returns the volatile storage path.

methods.name: DataPath
methods.description: Returns the data storage path.

methods.name: ProxyStubPath
methods.description: Returns the proxy stub path.

methods.name: SystemPath
methods.description: Returns the system path.

methods.name: PluginPath
methods.description: Returns the plugin path.

methods.name: SystemRootPath
methods.description: Returns or sets the system root path.

methods.name: StartMode
methods.description: Returns or sets the plugin start mode.

methods.name: Substituted Config value
methods.description: Returns a substituted configuration string.

methods.name: Resumed
methods.description: Returns or sets the resumed state.

methods.name: HashKey
methods.description: Returns a hash key for the plugin.

methods.name: ConfigLine
methods.description: Returns or sets the plugin configuration line.

methods.name: Metadata
methods.description: Returns plugin metadata information.

methods.name: SubSystems
methods.description: Provides access to plugin subsystems.

methods.name: Notify
methods.description: Sends a JSON-formatted notification message.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a plugin notification sink.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a plugin notification sink.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Returns the current plugin state.

methods.name: QueryInterfaceByCallsign
methods.description: Queries an interface by callsign.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Activates the plugin with a reason.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates the plugin with a reason.

methods.name: Unavailable
methods.description: Marks the plugin as unavailable with a reason.

methods.name: Hibernate
methods.description: Hibernates the plugin for a specified timeout.

methods.name: Reason
methods.description: Returns the current reason for plugin state.

methods.name: Submit
methods.description: Submits a JSON response to a channel.

methods.name: Register (overloads)
methods.description: Registers remote connection or connection server notifications.

methods.name: Unregister (overloads)
methods.description: Unregisters remote connection or connection server notifications.

methods.name: RemoteConnection
methods.description: Retrieves a remote connection by ID.

methods.name: EnablePersistentStorage
methods.description: Enables persistent storage with permissions and ownership.

methods.name: EnableVolatileStorage
methods.description: Enables volatile storage with permissions and ownership.

methods.name: Root
methods.description: Template method to get root interface of a specific type.

methods.name: QueryInterfaceByCallsign (template)
methods.description: Template method to query interface by callsign.

methods.name: GetLibrarySearchPaths
methods.description: Returns library search paths.
